steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses screen as required for this state.
Add the second bid at 90 to reproduce the two-bid setup without requiring a second vendor portal session.
Confirm the second bid was accepted.
Open the comparison grid before initiating the counter offer.
Send Vendor A's counter offer at 90 with the required remark.
Confirm the buyer's grid marks the counter offer as initiated.
Move to the separate vendor portal session while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the live RFQ pricing round where the pending counter offer is available.
Accept the pending counter offer as the vendor.
Return to the buyer's session to verify the accepted counter offer.
Return to the RFQ Responses tab.
Confirm the buyer's Responses grid marks the vendor's counter offer as accepted.
Verify the accepted counter offer is counted in the corresponding panel.
Verify the accepted price 90 is visible in Responses.
Open Master QCS to verify the accepted bid value in the comparison grid.
Assert that Master QCS uses the accepted rate of 90.
Assert the bid quantity is 10 for the expected total calculation.
Verify Master QCS shows the expected 90 × 10 total of 900.
